bike_path.whereNote: City parks and recreation areas. Riding is allowed only on an automobile road or a trail designated for these vehicles. The code also says bicycles are permitted on walkways and trails when the Director designates them. No designations were found.
bike_path.quote: It is unlawful for any person to ride or drive a bicycle, motorcycle, automobile or any other vehicle in any location in a City park or recreation area other than on an automobile road or trail designated to accommodate such vehicles.

sidewalk.whereNote: Any sidewalk where the City Engineer has posted a sign banning electric bicycles. No list of posted sidewalks was found.
sidewalk.quote: It is unlawful for any person to ride or operate an electric bicycle on any sidewalk within the City where the City Engineer has posted a sign prohibiting such use.

road.read: Read in full: SMC Ch. 10.22 Miscellaneous Provisions and the 10.02.020 definitions of bicycle and electric bicycle. Searched the full text of Titles 7, 8 and 10 for bicycle, bike, skate, scooter, wheeled device and trail, and read every match. 10.22.050 covers freeways only. 10.22.080 names motorcycles and power cycles on trails, not e-bikes.

bike_path.whereNote: County parks, which the code says include trails, open space preserves and ecological reserves. Riding is allowed only in areas designated for it, and the code adds that e-bikes are allowed pursuant to State law.
bike_path.quote: Ride or use a bicycle, E-bike, non-motorized scooter, skateboard, inline skates or other similar wheeled device except in areas designated for its use. (i) E-bikes allowed pursuant to State law.

bike_path.whereNote: County parks. The code bars operating a vehicle in a park outside park roadways and parking areas without written authorization. Whether this reaches e-bikes is unclear.
bike_path.quote: No person shall operate a vehicle in a County park other than on a park roadway designated for vehicle traffic or in a parking area designated for vehicle use without written authorization issued by the Department.

sidewalk.whereNote: Sidewalks in a business district. The Traffic Code does not define bicycle, so whether this reaches e-bikes is arguable.
sidewalk.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to ride a bicycle upon any sidewalk in a business district.
